# The caption above the panel names the language or the file.
$ ddev exec vendor/bin/typo3 cache:flush

# Long lines scroll sideways instead of wrapping, because a wrapped
# command is a command someone will copy wrongly. The panel is a tab
# stop, so that scroll is reachable without a mouse.
$ curl -sk https://example.test/ | head -c 120
caption: shell
note: There is no copy button: it would need a script, and this catalog spends its script budget on the four behaviours the platform has no element for.
